name: peaqos
description: Onboard machines and fleet operators to peaqOS — peaq's financial OS for autonomous machines — using the peaq-os-cli Python CLI. Handles machine registration, peaqID creation, Machine NFT minting, Machine Credit Rating (MCR) setup, event submission, fleet management, the full Scale / Machine Market flow (market onboarding, AI-agent pairing, service search, order placement incl. the x402 pay-per-request rail, and dispute resolution), and Stream data sales (publish signed encrypted chunks, grant or auto-deliver buyer access after payment, pay for and decrypt purchased data). Works on both agung testnet and mainnet. Adapts to developers and non-technical operators alike.

cli_dependency.notes: Scale / Machine Market commands require a CLI release that ships the `scale` command group. Stream commands require 0.0.5+; `stream distribute`/`pay`/`payproof`, `consume --download-url`, and x402 order payment require 0.0.6+. If `peaqos scale --help` or `peaqos stream --help` fails, upgrade with `pip install --upgrade peaq-os-cli`.
